items.followUp: Define intermolecular forces and identify two such forces between water molecules.

rubric.why: Intermolecular forces are attractions acting between molecules.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for defining them as forces of attraction between molecules.

rubric.why: Both named forces act between HCl molecules, and both are included in the model answer.
rubric.description: Identifies two intermolecular forces between HCl molecules.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming both dipole–dipole attraction and London dispersion forces.

modelAnswer: Intermolecular forces are forces of attraction between molecules.
Between HCl molecules, dipole–dipole attraction occurs: Hδ+···Clδ−.
London dispersion forces also act between HCl molecules.

items.followUp: Write and balance the chemical equation for the reaction of magnesium with oxygen.

rubric.why: This is the balanced equation for sodium reacting with oxygen to form sodium oxide.

modelAnswer: Sodium reacts with oxygen to form sodium oxide.

items.followUp: What is dilution? Explain how adding water affects the concentration of a solution.

rubric.why: Dilution decreases the concentration of a solution, as stated in the model answer.
rubric.description: States the effect of dilution on concentration.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that dilution decreases the solution’s concentration.

rubric.why: Adding solvent is the method of dilution stated in the model answer.
rubric.description: States how a solution is diluted.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that dilution is done by adding solvent.

modelAnswer: Dilution is the process of decreasing the concentration of a solution by adding more solvent.
The amount of solute remains the same while the solution becomes less concentrated.
